scope: Section 8 (Motivic Milnor fiber), every numbered result of the revised manuscript, with no input beyond the ACVF model and the Puiseux ambient of Section 5, except the etale chart hypotheses for smooth X listed under accepted_inputs. Lemma 8.2 as the definition of h_m (Hm.hm, hm_objectClass; localization Rloc and etaHm). Lemma 8.3 (Hm.lemma_8_3: eta h_m kills the natural part of J_var; hm_generator). Lemma 8.5 in set form (Truncation.lemma_8_5_sets) and for classes (fullClass, fullClass_cutoff, fullClass_scale; truncations are diagonal constructible, truncObject, definable_agree). Lemma 8.6 (chain_teq: special covariant chains preserve normalized truncation classes, with anisotropic cutoffs for centripetal steps; lift_class; integral_lift). Lemma 8.9 (PuiseuxValues.lemma_8_9, lemma_8_9_rat; Hrushovski-Loeser Lemma 8.5.2 proved directly, Prism.hasLimit_latticeSeries). Theorem 8.11 (theorem_8_11_rv_ring, theorem_8_11_quotient, theorem_8_11_vf; Milnor.theorem_8_11_milnor for X = A^d; theorem_8_11_smooth). (z:coeff:change) (Lemma86.milnor_zeta_coeff, z_coeff_change for X = A^d; zeta_coeff_of_form_one; MilnorSmoothJets.z_coeff_change_smooth for smooth affine X). Remark 8.14 (VolComparison.remark_8_14, milnor_fiber_vol, milnor_fiber_vol_smooth). Remark 8.15 (Remark815.remark_8_15_integral, remark_8_15, remark_8_15_affine, remark_8_15_smooth, remark_8_15_milnor, remark_8_15_milnor_smooth; SameType.same_type by quantifier elimination). Section 8.1.1, Lemma 8.7 and the general claims of Remark 8.13 were deleted from the manuscript by the author (review batch B06).
accepted_inputs: DiamondIntegral.Section8.Milnor.EtaleChart: etale chart of a smooth affine X at the origin (Hensel's lemma), an explicit hypothesis of the smooth-X results only (author instruction of 2026-11-21); proved for X = A^d (etaleChart_affine).

DiamondIntegral.Section8.Truncation.EtaleCoords: etale coordinates with a 1-Lipschitz inverse (Hensel's lemma), an explicit hypothesis of z_coeff_change_smooth only; it implies EtaleChart and is proved for X = A^d (etaleCoords_affine). See section 8/CITED-INPUTS.md.
